Aircraft.name: Prop WW2 - Babushka
Aircraft.Instructions:
Babushka By: HuskyDynamics
AG1: Arm Rear Gun AG8: Engine (Default On)
Yaw: Toe Brakes (use for taxiing since there is no tailwheel)
Notes: Though unwieldy on the ground and sluggish when fully loaded, the Babushka becomes surprisingly nimble in the air once its payload is expended. Its small size and deadly rear machine gun offer the perfect cover for sneaky raids over enemy targets if you can make it there undetected.
